---
  title: "L1vsRA ChIPseeker"
author: "Julianne (Yulia) Murthy and SM"
date: "2026-04-20"
---
 
Goal: this script serves to perform ChIPseeker analysis on CUT&Tag data and RNA-Seq data as an alternative to BETA. To see if there is an association between G4 presence/lack thereof and changes in transcription

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# INSTALL DEPENDENCIES
```{r}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(version = "3.20")

renv::install(c(
  "YuLab-SMU/GOSemSim",
  "YuLab-SMU/DOSE",
  "YuLab-SMU/ggtree",
  "YuLab-SMU/clusterProfiler",
  "GuangchuangYu/enrichplot@devel",
  "bioc::ChIPseeker",
  "bioc::org.Ce.eg.db",
  "bioc::TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.refGene"
))

renv::install(c("ggplot2", "dplyr"))

renv::snapshot()
```


# LOAD LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.refGene)
library(org.Ce.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rlist)
```


# PATHS
```{r}
# TxDb for C. elegans 
txdb <- TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.refGene

columns(org.Ce.eg.db)
keytypes(org.Ce.eg.db)
head(keys(org.Ce.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"), 20)

# BED file locations on hpc
bed_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_infiles/L1vsRA_ChIPseeker"

# Output directory 
out_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_outfiles/L1vsRA_ChIPseeker"

# input filenames
file_L1 <- file.path(bed_dir, "L1_BG4_HQfinal.bed")
file_RA <- file.path(bed_dir, "RepAd_BG4_HQfinal.bed")

# DESEQ SIGNIFICANT results
deseq <- read.csv(file.path(bed_dir, "DESeq2_L1vsRA_significant_genes.csv"))

```


# READ IN PEAK FILES
```{r}
peakL1 <- readPeakFile(file_L1)
peakRA <- readPeakFile(file_RA)

cat("L1 peaks:  ", length(peakL1), "\n") #2653
cat("RA peaks:", length(peakRA), "\n") #6423
```


# ANNOTATE PEAKS
## For C. elegans it appears +/- 3kb is correct, see Hunt-Newbury et al 2007 and Saito et al 2013; longest promoter studied appears to be ~2700bp
```{r}
peakAnnoL1 <- annotatePeak(
  peakL1,
  tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),
  TxDb      = txdb,
  annoDb    = "org.Ce.eg.db"
)

peakAnnoRA <- annotatePeak(
  peakRA,
  tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),
  TxDb      = txdb,
  annoDb    = "org.Ce.eg.db"
)
```


# QUICK VISUALIZATION
```{r}
# Feature bar plots
plotAnnoBar(peakAnnoL1)   + ggtitle("L1 — Peak Annotation")
plotAnnoBar(peakAnnoRA)   + ggtitle("RA — Peak Annotation")

# TSS binding distance sites
plotDistToTSS(peakAnnoL1, title = "L1 — Distance to TSS")
plotDistToTSS(peakAnnoRA, title = "RA — Distance to TSS")
```

# EXPORT FULL ANNOTATION CSVs
```{r}
# Convert to data frames
dfL1 <- as.data.frame(peakAnnoL1)
dfRA <- as.data.frame(peakAnnoRA)

# Write full annotation CSVs
write.csv(dfL1, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoL1_full.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dfRA, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoRepAd_full.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)

```


# FILTER FOR PROMOTER PEAKS (<=1kb, 1-2kb, 2-3kb of TSS)
```{r}
# Label;s that ChIPseeker uses
PROMOTER_LABELS <- c("Promoter (<=1kb)", "Promoter (1-2kb)", "Promoter (2-3kb)")

promL1 <- dfL1 %>%
  filter(annotation %in% PROMOTER_LABELS)

promRA <- dfRA %>%
  filter(annotation %in% PROMOTER_LABELS)

cat("L1 promoter peaks:  ", nrow(promL1), "/", nrow(dfL1), "\n") #2197 / 2648
cat("RA promoter peaks:", nrow(promRA), "/", nrow(dfRA), "\n") #5768 / 6416
```


# WRITE THE PROMOTER FILTERED CSVs
```{r}
write.csv(promL1, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoL1_promoter.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(promRA, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoRA_promoter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```


# COMBINED ANNOTATION BAR PLOT (L1 vs RA side by side)
```{r}

named_beds <- list("L1" = file_L1, "Reproductive adult" = file_RA)
peakAnnoList <- lapply(named_beds, annotatePeak,
                       TxDb       = txdb,
                       tssRegion  = c(-3000, 3000),
                       verbose    = FALSE)

png(file.path(out_dir, "annoBar_L1_vs_RA.png"), width = 7, height = 4,
    units = "in", res = 300)
plotAnnoBar(peakAnnoList)
dev.off()

png(file.path(out_dir, "distToTSS_L1_vs_RA.png"), width = 7, height = 4,
    units = "in", res = 300)
plotDistToTSS(peakAnnoList, title = "G4 distance to TSS — L1 vs RA")
dev.off()

```


# INNERJOIN SIG DEGs & PROMOTER G4s
```{r}
# No header on original deseq file, add in SYMBOL column to join later
colnames(deseq)[1] <- "SYMBOL"

# Use inner_join() function to match G4 peaks within 3kb of the TSS (“promoter” G4s) to differentially expressed gene
G4_DEG_L1 <- inner_join(promL1, deseq, by = "SYMBOL") 
G4_DEG_RA <- inner_join(promRA, deseq, by = "SYMBOL") 

# Check how many genes overlapped
cat("L1 promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_L1), "\n") #766
cat("RA promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_RA), "\n")  #2016

# Export to CSV
write.csv(G4_DEG_L1, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_L1.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(G4_DEG_RA, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_RA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
